assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 Vijay Television 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：Vijay TV / Vijay Television Network。企业隶属关系链。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言（泰米尔语）。
  6. 主要内容类别（印度电视连续剧）。
  7. 内容供应模式：广播电视机构的节目存档。
  8. 代表性系列。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，Vijay Television 排名第 36 名，历史累计观看量约为 61B（610 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 Vijay Television 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
COMPREHENSIVE DOSSIER: VIJAY TELEVISION YOUTUBE CHANNEL

=== 1. STABLE CHANNEL ID AND CANONICAL URL ===

  • Channel ID: UCvrhwpnp2DHYQ1CbXby9ypQ
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCvrhwpnp2DHYQ1CbXby9ypQ
  • Custom handle/URL: @VijayTelevision (https://www.youtube.com/vijaytelevision)
    Source: YouTube channel page; Social Blade profile [1][2]

=== 2. OPERATOR AND CORPORATE CHAIN ===

  • Operator: Vijay Television (commonly referred to as STAR VIJAY), part of the JioStar network.
  • JioStar is a joint venture between Viacom18 and Disney India.
  • Full corporate chain:
    • Launched 24 November 1994 as Golden Eagle Communication (GEC) by N. P. V. Ramasamy Udayar
    • Acquired by United Breweries Group in 1995, renamed Vijay TV
    • UTV Group bought controlling interest in 1999 for ₹180 million
    • Star India took over in 2001 (51% stake), rebranded as Star Vijay
    • UTV offloaded its entire stake to Star India in 2004
    • Subsequently absorbed into Disney's acquisition of Star India
    • Current ownership: JioStar (Viacom18 + Disney India JV)
    Sources: Wikipedia (Star Vijay) [3]; YouTube channel description [1]

=== 3. CHANNEL CREATION DATE AND EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD ===

  • Created on: February 1, 2007
    Sources: Social Blade [2]; VidIQ [4]; Wikitubia sidebar [5]; TubeLeader [6]
  • Earliest still-public uploads: The channel was created in 2007 but no publicly accessible videos from before 2012 were found on the official channel. The earliest identified uploads date to approximately March–May 2012:
    • "Adhu Idhu Yedhu 03/17/12" — uploaded March 17, 2012 [7]
    • "Neeya Naana 03/18/12" — uploaded ~March/April 2012 [8]
    • "Lollu Sabha" episode clips — uploaded ~14 years ago (~March 2012) [9]
    • "Vijay Awards 06/06/08" — uploaded May 30, 2012 [10]
    Note: Pre-2012 uploads may exist but were not located through search; many early uploads were likely removed due to copyright or channel restructuring.

=== 4. OPERATING LOCATION AND DISPLAYED COUNTRY ===

  • Operating location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India (registered office at Thiru Vi Ka Industrial Estate, Guindy, Chennai; also Nungambakkam address historically)
  • Displayed country: India
    Sources: Wikipedia (Star Vijay) [3]; Facebook page [11]; Qoruz profile [12]; Communitrics [13]

=== 5. LANGUAGE ===

  • Primary language: Tamil
  • Confirmed by channel description: "a leading Tamil Language Entertainment Channel broadcasting innovative shows & programs from India" [1]
  • Note: Wikipedia's "List of most-viewed YouTube channels" erroneously lists Hindi as primary language [14], which contradicts the channel's own description, all content evidence, and every other source consulted.
    Sources: YouTube description [1]; Qoruz [12]; Star Vijay Wikipedia [3]

=== 6. PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY ===

  • Category: Entertainment (Indian TV serials, reality shows, promotional content)
  • Wikitubia classifies style as "Entertainment" [5]
  • Qoruz categorizes content as Arts & Entertainment (97.81%), Business (2.2%) [12]
  • Communitrics categories: Music, Entertainment; topics include Movies, TV shows, Entertainment [13]
  • Content consists primarily of episode clips, promos, full episodes, and award-show recordings from its television broadcasts
    Sources: Wikitubia sidebar [5]; Qoruz [12]; Communitrics [13]

=== 7. CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL ===

  • Model: Broadcaster archives — the channel serves as the digital distribution arm of the Star Vijay TV network, uploading its own broadcast content including:
    • Episode clips and full episodes of serials/reality shows
    • Promotional material (episode previews, show promos)
    • Award ceremonies (Annual Vijay Television Awards)
    • Channel idents and branding content
  • Video titles follow a consistent pattern: "[Show Name] [DD/MM/YY]" indicating direct extraction from TV air dates (e.g., "Super Singer 03/08/13", "Neeya Naana 03/18/12") [8][9][10]
    Sources: Channel video patterns observed across multiple pages [7][8][9][10]

=== 8. REPRESENTATIVE SERIES ===
Current and notable series (from Wikipedia List of programs broadcast by Star Vijay) [15]:

  • Serials: Siragadikka Aasai, Pandian Stores 2, Chinna Marumagal, Mahanadhi, Azhagae Azhagu, Suttum Vizhi Sudare
  • Reality/Non-fiction: Super Singer (2006–present), Super Singer Junior (2007–present), Bigg Boss Tamil (2017–present), Cooku with Comali (2019–present), Kalakka Povathu Yaaru? (2005–present), Neeya Naana (talk show), Jodi Number One (2006–2019), Lollu Sabha (2003–2008)
  • Former popular serials: Saravanan Meenatchi (2011–2018), Pandian Stores (2018–2023), Baakiyalakshmi (2020–2025), Bharathi Kannamma (2019–2023), Eeramana Rojave (2018–2021), Raja Rani (2017–2019)
    Sources: Wikipedia List of programs [15]; YouTube channel playlists [8][9]

=== 9. KEY METRICS (for context) ===

  • Subscribers: ~28.7M [2][13]
  • Lifetime views: ~61B (Communitrics, as of Sept 2026) [13]; ~58.8B (Wikipedia list) [14]; ~61.1B (Social Blade) [2]
  • Global rank by subscribers: #396 (Communitrics) [13]
  • Rank on Wikipedia "most-viewed channels" list: #36 [14]
  • Videos: ~148K [2]
  • Upload frequency: ~33/day average [2]
